features.title: Account metrics
features.notes: Live ceilings (quest DB sum, collection-log varp) since 0.3.0; over-max targets allowed since 0.3.0; leagues metrics hidden off-profile since 0.3.0. Each metric declares AccountMetric.decays(): the two that can lose value (Miscellania favour, spendable slayer points) have their completion re-derived from the live varbit every tick, so the goal re-opens when the value drops below target and completes again when it recovers; every other metric keeps sticky completion. A 5s post-login settle window stops the pre-sync zero read from un-completing them.

features.title: Repeatable goals
features.notes: Stage 1: manual repeat on CUSTOM goals. Goal.repeatEvery (NONE/DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY) + lastPeriodKey; rollover compares integer period keys rather than differencing timestamps, so N periods offline resets once and DST is java.time's problem. Driven by a 1-minute Swing timer, NOT onGameTick - CUSTOM goals need no client data and the boundary is usually crossed while logged out. Repeatable goals live in a derived built-in section (Section.BuiltInKind.REPEATABLE, ORDER_REPEATABLE = MIN_VALUE, pinned top) that the panel hides while empty - the only built-in that hides. reconcileDerivedSections checks repeating BEFORE complete, so a checked-off daily never graduates to Completed; that mutual exclusion is what lets both mechanisms share archivedFromSectionId. Boundary configurable (game reset UTC default / local midnight / custom hour). See docs/decisions/0003 and 0004. NOT yet done: deadline group headers with a live 'resets in' countdown (RepeatSchedule.formatCountdown exists and is tested but is not wired to the panel). Auto-tracked types repeat via derived goals - see repeatable-goals-from-skills-and-items.

features.title: Repeatable goals from skills and items
features.notes: Right-click a long-term goal -> 'Repeatable goal' -> period -> size, creating a repeating slice of it. A SKILL parent yields an XP chunk on the same skill; an item parent yields a kill-count goal at whatever activity drops it, resolved by ItemActivityResolver joining item-sources.tsv (itemId -> source label) with boss-killcount.tsv (boss -> KC varp). Goal.repeatChunk + derivedFromGoalId; the parent is never mutated. Key decision: NO baseline field. At rollover the target re-bases to currentValue + chunk (RepeatResetService) rather than progress being cleared, so every existing tracker works unchanged AND the rollover reads only stored state - which is what keeps resets working while logged out. Clearing progress instead would be silently undone by the next tracker tick, since trackers report a lifetime total. A missed period re-bases to one chunk, never accumulating. Creation reads live XP/KC and returns null if it cannot, rather than shipping a bogus target that self-completes. Coverage: BOSS + RAID source labels join at 90%+ after reconciling case, leading articles, group labels (Dagannoth Kings, Moons of Peril) and ' and ' pairs; the 2 residual gaps are pinned by test. MINIGAME is excluded on purpose - all 22 minigame labels resolve to nothing because their counters are the collection_minigames_* varbits the plugin does not read yet. ~48% of items are category OTHER and correctly get no menu entry at all. Repeat fields ride share codes additively (repeatEvery + repeatChunk, plugin ADR-0006): the chunk travels, the re-based target does not, and a pre-0.5.0 recipient imports a one-shot. MCP emits the same fields.
